repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `c2192006fe3bf5b21524fff803115d68421d9704`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset; no published schema and no governed path in the tree). Inputs read: card #37559 body and all five comments (triage, claim 7198419752, os-dev-report 7200935606, claim amendment 7200954627, os-dev-report 7201706069), the PR body, its four files, the net diff against merge-base `05563a57f0`, and the 52 check-runs on this head. All of them concluded `success` or `skipped`; none failed.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff implies:

- **`@object-ui/plugin-form/core` gains `resolveColSpan`.** It is a new name on an `exports`-addressable subpath (`./core`, typed by `./dist/core.d.ts`). The package root (`src/index.tsx`) exports `applyAutoColSpan` but not `resolveColSpan`, so this is the name's first publication from the package, not a re-export. The PR body's acceptance note and the changeset have this right. The amendment's parenthesis has it wrong (see F4). The judgment is **right**: one widening, nothing removed or renamed, and the signature `(field: FormField, gridColumns: number, sectionColumns?: number)`, returning `number`, uses only an already-published type.
- **Is it the narrowest export that serves the page? Yes, at the right grain.** The spec docblock on `FormFieldSchema.span` names `resolveColSpan` as the read point. The page builds one `RenderableField` row at a time, and `resolveColSpan` is the per-field primitive. Reusing `applyAutoColSpan` would need it on `/core` too (also a new `/core` name). It would also mean wrapping rows into a `FormField[]` and reading `colSpan` back off the result, so it is no narrower. Importing from the package root (option B) would pull the registering renderers into the `/forms` chunk. `autoLayout.ts` was already in `/core`'s closure (`inferColumns`, `isWideFieldType`, `containerGridColsFor`), so the bundle split does not change.
- **The console's named-form page now reads `FormFieldSchema.span`.** This is a renderer starting to honour a key the spec already declares. Nothing new can be authored, so the behaviour change sits under `Metadata-protocol: none`, which is **right**. It also starts clamping an authored `colSpan` to the section's column count, which the spec's `colSpan` describe already promises. Before, `colSpan: 4` in a 2-column section emitted `sm:col-span-4`.
- **Does the page honour `span` exactly as the record form does? Almost, with one divergence (F2).** `span: 'full'`, an authored `colSpan` and the type-based wide default match: the type goes through `mapFieldTypeToFormType` with the effective `multiple`, as `sectionFields.ts` does. The page's grid has one multi-column tier (`sm:grid-cols-N`), so a single `sm:col-span-N` class is the whole row at every multi-column tier, which meets the spec's per-tier sentence.

Findings:

- **F1 · should-fix:** `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/core.ts` header states the subpath's own invariant: "The same names are still exported from the package root, unchanged." Before this diff, every `/core` name was also a root name. The earlier precedent, `FormOwnerLineContext`, went to both. `resolveColSpan` is now the one `/core` name the root does not export, so the header is false at this head. Either add `resolveColSpan` to the root's `./autoLayout` export block (still `yes (widening)`, still `patch`; widen the changeset sentence to name both entry points), or rewrite the header sentence so it no longer claims root parity. The first keeps the documented rule and the precedent.
- **F2 · should-fix:** `FormPage.tsx` passes the wide-default stash as `field: { multiple: override.multiple ?? def.multiple }`. The spec text (`span` describe, `view.zod.ts`) says "a file or image field whose **object field** declares `multiple: true`". `autoLayout.ts`'s `isWideFormField` docblock says `multiple` is read off the object-field definition "and nothing else". The record form stashes the object field itself (`sectionFields.ts` `fromObjectSchema`, `field: withFormObject(... field ...)`). So for a `file` or `image` field whose form-view entry sets `multiple` differently from its object field, the two renderers disagree on `span: 'auto'`. A view restating `multiple: true` over a single-file object field goes full row here and stays one cell on the record form, and the reverse also holds. `mapFieldTypeToFormType` maps `file` to `field:file` whatever `multiple` is, so `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES` matches on both paths and only the stash decides. Fix: stash `def.multiple` (the object field's declaration). The `type:` argument keeps the effective `multiple`, as it does now. Add a pin for the multi-file arm, which has none: an object field with `multiple: true` takes the full row, and a view-only `multiple: true` over a single-file object field stays one cell.
- **F3 · nit:** the changeset and the PR body claim that an authored `colSpan` is now "clamped to the section's column count", and no pin observes the clamp. The fourth case only checks `colSpan: 2` in a 4-column section. A `colSpan: 4` in a 2-column section expecting 2 cells would pin it.
- **F4 · nit:** the PR body's `Clause-②:` line carries the amendment's parenthesis verbatim, "which is already public from the package root", and that is false at this head. The arm parses as `widening` either way, and the acceptance note corrects it. Still, the declaration line is the one a reader greps, so it should read true where it stands: drop or correct the parenthesis. The changeset already carries the bare arm.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is **right**: one new published name (`resolveColSpan` on `@object-ui/plugin-form/core`), nothing narrowed. With F1's root-export fix it stays `yes (widening)`.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is **right**: the spec already declares `span` and `colSpan`. A renderer honouring them changes nothing an author can write.
- The level is **right**: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `patch` for `@object-ui/console`. AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3) says a `none` kind takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Both packages are released (neither is `private`), and each package that moves has its changeset line. `skip-changeset` would have been wrong and was not used. `Check Changeset` concluded `success`.
- Clause-②: yes (widening) — the declared line and the arm match what the diff publishes, and the PR body and the changeset agree on value and arm. F4 is about the PR body's parenthesis only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions (report 7200935606), the `/core` reach A/B/C:** answered by amendment 7200954627, which chose A. I concur, for the reasons in ①. The second report (7201706069) has `open_questions: []`.
- **Dev flag: repeater on `span: 'auto'` resolves to one cell on both form renderers.** Escalated to the seat to file as a card. I confirmed it by reading: `ui/packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts` maps `repeater: 'field:object'`, which is not in `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`. The spec's `span` describe says repeater "reaches it through the wide `field:grid` widget it maps to", so a declared default is not delivered. This is a contract the runtime does not honour (Prime Directive 10), so it needs a card, not "noted, not filed". It predates this diff and affects both renderers, so it is not a finding on this PR.
- **Dev flag: app-shell `FormFieldSpec` declares `colSpan` but not `span`.** Accepted as noted. The page reads the served entry's `span` through a narrow cast, the way `resolveColSpan` itself reads it. No producer stores through that type, so no card is needed for this PR's correctness. If the seat wants the type honest, it is an optional follow-up.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5):** no finding. The diff adds no data access, no id materialisation and no in-app join. It changes only a pure per-row width computation over already-loaded metadata.
- **Security-touching:** no.
- The author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37559-form-page-span`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA`

**VERDICT: PASS**

The declaration face holds: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch` are right for this diff. F1 and F2 are should-fix and stay open. Per the landing pre-check, this head does not land until a delta closes them and that delta is read.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `7ea307df8ac1b6be6961b65f21159989e042d8c8`
Local-runs: none

Delta round on the declaration face (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset; no published schema and no governed path in the tree). The earlier record is 7202175363 at head `c2192006fe`. Inputs read: card #37559 body and all six comments (the new one is os-dev-report 7202598631), the PR body, its five files, the net diff against merge-base `dedc16c103`, the PR-file delta `c2192006fe..7ea307df8a` (four files: changeset, pin, FormPage.tsx, index.tsx; core.ts unchanged), and the 56 check-runs on this head. Every one concluded `success` or `skipped`; none failed. `Test UI` (16 shards), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` and `Check Changeset` are all `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public-surface changes the net diff implies:

- **`@object-ui/plugin-form` publishes `resolveColSpan` from two entry points: the root `.` (`./dist/index.d.ts`) and `./core` (`./dist/core.d.ts`).** Both are `exports`-addressable. This is one new name and nothing is removed or renamed. The signature `(field: FormField, gridColumns: number, sectionColumns?: number)` returns `number` and uses only an already-published type. The judgment is **right**. The root addition joins the existing `./autoLayout` group, which already pulls that module, so the root's closure and the `plugin-form-core` chunk group do not change.
- **The console's named-form page now reads `FormFieldSchema.span`, and it clamps an authored `colSpan` to the section's column count.** A renderer now honours keys the spec already declares, which is **right** under `Metadata-protocol: none`. The call passes `cols` (the section's normalised column count), and `resolveColSpan` clamps to it (`autoLayout.ts`, `Math.min(..., grid)`). The `as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4` cast is sound, because `clampGrid` caps the grid at 4.
- **The wide default now reads only the object field's `multiple`.** The stash is `field: { multiple: def.multiple }`, and the `type:` argument still carries the effective `multiple`. This matches the spec's `span` text ("a file or image field whose object field declares `multiple: true`"), `isWideFormField` (`field.field?.multiple === true`) and `sectionFields.ts`. The two form renderers now agree on `span: 'auto'` for `file` and `image`. **Right.**

Findings from the earlier record:

- **F1: closed.** `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx` exports `resolveColSpan` in its `./autoLayout` group, next to `applyAutoColSpan`. I read every value and type name in `core.ts`'s export list at this head against the root (18 names), and each one is also a root export. The header sentence "The same names are still exported from the package root, unchanged" is true again, following the `FormOwnerLineContext` precedent. The changeset sentence now names both entry points.
- **F2: closed.** `FormPage.tsx` stashes `def.multiple` and has a comment on why. Two pins cover it. `attachments` (an object field with `multiple: true`) on `span: 'auto'` takes 2 of 2 cells. The CONTROL `receipt` (a single-file object field with a form-level `multiple: true`) stays 1 cell. The dev's ablation 2 (stash put back to `override.multiple ?? def.multiple`) turns only that CONTROL red, so the pin observes the stash and not the widget type.
- **F3: closed.** The new case `{ field: 'owner', colSpan: 4 }` in a 2-column section expects 2 cells. Ablation 1 reads it red as `expected 4 to be 2`, so it observes the clamp.
- **F4: closed.** The PR body's line now reads `Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/plugin-form exports resolveColSpan from its root and its /core subpath)`. That is true at this head, and the arm is unchanged.

New finding:

- **F5 · nit:** the PR body is stale in two places. Under `## Verification` it says "Expected: 4 passed", but the pin file now has 7 cases. "Read first, by risk" item 2 names only `core.ts` as "the new public name", but the name is now also on the root through `index.tsx`. This is prose on the PR body only. It does not affect correctness or the contract, and the changeset and `## What changes` are right.

The `rowOf` helper's wait moved from `getByLabelText` to `getByText(label, { selector: 'label, label *' })`, so the upload widget's group-labelled control can be found. Every case still reads the span class off the label's grid cell, so no earlier assertion is weaker.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is **right**. One new published name sits on two `exports` entries, and nothing is narrowed. The PR body and the changeset agree on the value and the arm.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is **right**. `span` and `colSpan` are already declared, and nothing new can be authored.
- The level is **right**: `patch` for `@object-ui/console` and `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-form` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`). Both packages move, and each has its line. `skip-changeset` is not used, and it would be wrong here. `Check Changeset` concluded `success`.
- Clause-②: yes (widening) — the declared line and the arm match what the diff publishes (`resolveColSpan` on `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/plugin-form/core`).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions:** report 7202598631 has `open_questions: []`. The earlier `/core` reach question (report 7200935606) was answered by amendment 7200954627, and F1 has now made it whole.
- **Dev flag, repeater on `span: 'auto'`:** the earlier record escalated it. It now has a carrier, #37677, and it is out of this PR. This flag is closed.
- **Dev flag, app-shell `FormFieldSpec` lacks `span`:** accepted as noted, as before. The narrow cast is commented at the call site.
- **#37671 landing after this PR:** this PR's pins would catch the likely regressions. #37671 rewrites how `cols` is derived, directly above this PR's `resolveColSpan(..., cols)` call, and it adds `sectionedGridLayout` to the same export lists in `core.ts` and `index.tsx`. If that rebase drops the call or its import, ablation 1 shows four cases going red. If it drops the `/core` export, every case throws on the import, and `Type Check UI` goes red too. Under #37671's rule, a single declared section on an undeclared form still resolves to its declared count (`sectionColumnsFor`, and the grid is the widest section). So these pins stay valid across it, and a change in the count that `resolveColSpan` receives would show up in them. The pins do not reach the form-level `columns` path: no case sets the form view's own `columns`, so a section clamped by it is not observed here. That pin belongs to #37671.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5):** no finding. The diff adds no data access, no id materialisation and no in-app join. It only computes a width per row over metadata that is already loaded.
- **Security-touching:** no.
- The author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37559-form-page-span`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA`

**VERDICT: PASS**

F1 and F2 (should-fix) are closed at this head, and so are nits F3 and F4. The only open item is the nit F5, so this is the final round. F5 is recorded as an accepted deviation on PR prose; correcting it touches only the body. No should-fix or must-fix finding is open.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 7ea307df8a · card #37559 · area s2-ux-S · 2026-11-26T20:46Z

**L1 checklist**
- **Shape and relation.** `l1-face.mjs --pr 37672` on this head; every check is success or an expected skip. The branch merged `main` once (c165bf1366) and added one fix commit.
- **`Fixes #37559` is right.** The named-form page (`/forms/NAME`) now resolves each field's columns with the record form's own resolver: `span: 'full'`, an authored `colSpan` (clamped to the section's columns) and the type-based wide default all match, and the wide default reads only the object field's own `multiple`.
- **Contract review.** Record 7202175363 PASS with F1, F2 open → delta 7203050865 on this head: PASS, F1–F4 closed, one nit F5 (the PR body's Verification still says "4 passed" for a 7-case file) accepted as a deviation. Adopted.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` — `@object-ui/plugin-form` exports `resolveColSpan` from its root and `/core`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; `patch` on `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`. True.
- **Order with #37671.** #37671 edits the same three files; this PR's pins catch a dropped call or export if #37671 lands after it, and the form-view `columns` clamp is #37671's own to pin.
- **Out of scope.** A `repeater` on `span: 'auto'` taking one cell predates this PR and is #37677.
- **Governance.** `check-governed-merges.mjs`: not governed. Tier S.

Tier: S. Landing: ready + auto-merge by this stroke.
